content:
A pleading tells the Court why you are there. The Prayer Clause tells the Court what you want. ⚖️

The Prayer Clause is one of the most important parts of a pleading because it clearly sets out the relief or remedy being sought from the Court.

A well-drafted prayer should be clear, specific, and connected to the facts and legal basis of the case.

📌 In this DraftKaari guide, we cover:

 • What is a Prayer Clause?
 • What does it generally contain?
 • How should the relief be drafted?
 • A key distinction between the Cause of Action and Prayer Clause.

Clear pleadings. Specific relief. Stronger drafting.

Draft Like a Lawyer. Argue Like a Pro.

Gaurang Singh
Sazda Aziz
